corrections.text: The article says OpenAI's Pando post states that 'starting around the end of last year' the systems supporting its monorepo were struggling. The post is dated November 2, 2026, so 'last year' is 2025; the article should have given the calendar date rather than OpenAI's relative wording.

The article cites The New Stack for the report that OpenAI is not open-sourcing Pando and for the Entire and Origin comparison, and does not mention that the cited New Stack article states: 'TNS owner Insight Partners is an investor in: OpenAI, Anthropic.' OpenAI is the subject of this article.
